# =============================================================================
# 0_Setupmodel.Rmd
# Purpose : Create the folder structure for one time-series analysis project.
# Usage   : Run this FIRST, once per project. It only creates empty
#           data/output/figures folders under projects/<name>/.
#           Then place the input CSVs (see 1_timeseriesAnalysis.Rmd header)
#           into projects/<name>/data/ before running 1_timeseriesAnalysis.Rmd.
# =============================================================================

```{r Initialise}
# Only requires base R

# Core folders
projects <- file.path(getwd(), "projects")

```



Copy all needed files for the model.
```{r Create project}

name <- "2000_2024_changing_point"

# If project not already created make sure it is not overwritten
if (!file.exists(file.path(projects, name, "data", "hiv_data.csv"))) {
    # Create project folders 
    dir.create(file.path(projects, name))
    dir.create(file.path(projects, name,"data"))
    dir.create(file.path(projects, name,"output"))
    dir.create(file.path(projects, name, "figures"))
   
}

```
